title: What's new
lead: What changed in Tavvit, newest first.

1.33.2.title: A new product page, banners and tooltips

items.landing: The product page is new. It reads like a space: its chapters stand in a column of their own and turn read as you go, Ctrl K jumps between them, and pointing at the app's window lights the part it names.
items.banners: A space's banner now heads its channel list, on the desktop and on the phone, and its card on Home.
items.home: Your spaces come first on Home, as large cards with their banner, what is new in them and who is talking.
items.sidebar: Explore and About fold under More in Home's column, and a space has one Create row for channels and categories.
items.tooltips: Every button that shows only an icon names itself as soon as the pointer rests on it or the keyboard reaches it.
items.search: Home has no second search field any more: the one in the top bar opens the same.

1.33.1.title: Deleting an account that owns spaces

items.admin: Administrators can delete an account together with the spaces it owns, for a name nobody should carry or an account made for spam. Each space goes on the record.

items.watch: Watch a YouTube or Vimeo video or a video file together in a voice channel. Everyone sees the same moment, and anyone in the call can pause, skip or add to the queue.
items.steer: Whoever starts can choose to steer alone, and the video gets quieter while someone speaks.
items.reactions: Reactions rise over the picture, and the channel list shows what a voice channel is watching.
items.privacy: A video from YouTube or Vimeo loads on your device only after your yes, and nothing of what you watch is stored.

1.32.8.title: Safer accounts, calls and links between servers

items.accounts: A new account that still has to confirm its address can only read in spaces until it has, and throwaway addresses can be refused at sign-up.
items.privacy: Banners and the icons of groups and spaces from other servers wait for your yes too, and the privacy notice says plainly that messages are not end-to-end encrypted.
items.voice: Muting or deafening someone in a voice channel now holds even when their app ignores it.
items.limits: Sounds, group pictures and files from bots count towards the storage an account may use, and an account can be in at most 100 groups.
items.signin: Guessing passwords is slowed down everywhere a password is asked for, without keeping you out of your own account.
items.desktop: The desktop app only listens for shortcuts that cannot type text, on any keyboard layout.
items.federation: Between servers, a server has to prove its address before it is trusted, and nobody is put into a group, chat, call or friend request here that they would not accept.

items.privacy: Pictures and invites from other servers wait for your yes before they load, in invite cards, in Outer Space and on links to an invite elsewhere too.
items.limits: The server refuses oversized requests before it reads them, and no account can fill its disk by forwarding or uploading over and over.
items.moderation: Someone kicked or banned is out of the space's voice and news at once and can no longer edit old messages. Taking a channel out of a private category takes the right to manage roles.
items.previews: Link previews and media files can no longer be turned against the server's own network.
items.federation: Between servers, only those taking part may answer or end a call, and an account can no longer claim someone else's identity.

items.start: 1.32.5 did not start on servers that send mail through Resend. 1.32.6 does, and every version is now started that way once before it ships.

items.files: Files sent before the last update also get addresses nobody can guess, over the next days.
items.shortcuts: Shortcuts in the desktop app need Ctrl, Alt or the system key for letters, digits and Space, so the app never hears what you type in other programs.
items.server: Under the hood, the server runs on a newer framework, with stricter checks on where a request comes from.

items.media: Stickers, profile pictures and icons only come from this server or from the server a person lives on. A sticker from anywhere else waits until you choose to load it.
items.voice: A private voice channel stays private: nobody who cannot see it can join it or see who is in it.
items.files: Uploaded files get addresses nobody can guess.

items.icons: A space can give each channel its own icon, one of the set or an emoji, in place of the channel type icon.

items.username: You can now change your username in your account settings, once in 30 days.
items.roadmap: The roadmap shows what comes next.

items.translate: Right-click a message, or hold it on a phone, and choose Translate. The translation stands under the original, and you choose the language in your settings.

1.32.0.title: Forums, announcements and an address of your own

items.forums: A forum channel keeps questions and topics apart as posts: each has a title, tags and its own conversation, and the list follows what is going on.
items.announcements: An announcement channel is written by a few and read by everyone. Other spaces can follow it, and each post then also arrives in their channel.
items.address: A space can have an invite address in words, such as /join/night-shift, that never runs out.

1.31.0.title: Much faster when many people are here

items.speed: Messages arrive quickly even with a thousand people online, and starting the app takes far less data.
items.pages: This page is new, and so are a help page and a status page.
items.safety: A signed-out or suspended account is put out of a voice call at once.

items.docs: Everything about bots and webhooks, with a quickstart, at /developers.

items.cards: Bots can show cards with titles, fields and pictures.
items.commands: Slash commands can ask for things, and answer you alone.
items.portal: A page of your own for your bots: picture, token, invite address.

items.storage: See how much room your files take up under Settings, Account.

items.games: The desktop app asks Steam, Epic and GOG directly which game you are playing.

items.bots: Bots can join spaces, with slash commands, under the rights a space gives them.

items.voice: Record a voice message right in the chat.
items.saved: Save messages, and be reminded of them.
items.alerts: Get alerted when someone writes a word you choose.
items.soundboard: Play clips to everyone in a call with the soundboard.

items.threads: Follow a side conversation in a thread of its own.
items.events: Plan events in a space, with reminders.
items.welcome: Spaces can welcome new members and ask them to accept the rules.

1.23.0.title: More you can do with a message

items.pins: Pin messages, hide spoilers, forward, and hold polls.
items.push: Get notifications while the app is closed.
